lines.zh: 我用四条腿走，身子压得很低。
lines.en: I go on four limbs, my body held low.

lines.zh: 每一步爪子都抠进土里。
lines.en: Each step digs claws into the dirt.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞穴的顶爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl along the cave ceiling.

lines.zh: 石壁上留下四道并排的痕。
lines.en: Four parallel lines stay on the stone.

lines.zh: 我绕过石笋，脊背擦着它。
lines.en: I slip past a stalagmite, my spine grazing it.

lines.zh: 我走路的节奏不像活物。
lines.en: My gait doesn't sound like a living thing.
I shift slowly out of the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把一条腿放平。
lines.en: I stop and lay one limb flat.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，肚子摩擦石块。
lines.en: I slide close to the floor, belly scraping stone.
I walk and listen to the echoes.

lines.zh: 我的四肢轮流落地，很轻。
lines.en: My limbs land in turn, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我绕到那根柱子的背面。
lines.en: I move around to the far side of the pillar.
I stand in the cave mouth, perfectly still.
Four limbs braced, head hanging low.
I haven't blinked in a long while.
Water drips and lands on my back.
I turn my head a fraction.
The cave is dark; I can see.
One of my joints clicks now and then.

lines.zh: 我的气味让附近的虫都不叫了。
lines.en: My smell has silenced the nearby insects.
I'm listening to something deeper in.

lines.zh: 地上有我先前留下的痕。
lines.en: My earlier marks are still on the floor.

lines.zh: 我一动不动站着，像块石头。
lines.en: I stand like a stone.
I draw one limb in.
No one has come here in a long time.

lines.zh: 我把头压到两条前腿之间。
lines.en: I lower my head between my forelimbs.

lines.zh: 我从洞口看着你，你已经进来了。
lines.en: I watch from the cave mouth; you're already inside.

lines.zh: 你点亮了火把，我的眼睛反光。
lines.en: You lit a torch, and my eyes catch the light.

lines.zh: 我不动，四只眼睛都对着你。
lines.en: I don't move; every eye is on you.
Your steps are loud in here.
I wait for you to come to me.

lines.zh: 你看不到我，我在你的光外面。
lines.en: You can't see me; I'm outside your light.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口你带来的空气。
lines.en: I take in the air you brought with you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在这洞里太清楚了。
lines.en: Your breathing is far too clear in here.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，从你进来开始。
lines.en: I've watched you since you entered.
Don't back up; if you do, I'll follow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地从洞口站起来。
lines.en: I rise slowly from the cave mouth.
You can't count my limbs properly.

lines.zh: 你能听见我的关节响吗？
lines.en: Can you hear my joints clicking?
I'm three paces from you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛开始适应黑暗了。
lines.en: Your eyes are starting to adjust.
Only when you turn and run will I make a sound.
I roll over, limbs scrabbling.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的一条腿。
lines.en: The blow breaks one of my limbs.

lines.zh: 我叫了，声音不像是我的。
lines.en: I scream, and it doesn't sound like me.
I back into a crack in the stone.
Blood runs down with the water.
I press to the floor, breathing loudly.
My joints seize for a moment.
I tuck the wounded side under me.
I crawl slowly, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼睛还在找你。
lines.en: I lift my head, eyes still hunting you.
There's nothing to eat down here.
I push it aside.

lines.zh: 它滚下去，在石头上撞了两声。
lines.en: It rolls away and knocks twice on stone.
You hold it up, and I don't understand.
I never eat what's picked off the floor.

lines.zh: 我伸爪拍了一下，它就碎了。
lines.en: I bat it once and it breaks.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，抬头走开。
lines.en: I sniff it and walk away.

lines.zh: 这味道和石头没有区别。
lines.en: It smells the same as the stone.
Keep it; I don't need it.
I go around it and keep watching you.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我四条腿都没挪。
lines.en: You hit me and none of my limbs shift.

lines.zh: 我从墙上弹开，落地就稳了。
lines.en: I bounce off the wall and land steady.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，尘土落下。
lines.en: We collide and dust falls from the ceiling.
I let the blow carry me two paces back.
I make a short, low sound.

lines.zh: 这一撞让洞顶掉下碎石。
lines.en: The impact knocks pebbles from the roof.
I go around you, deeper in.

lines.zh: 你比这里的石头软多了。
lines.en: You're far softer than this stone.

lines.zh: 我站定了，又回到那个姿势。
lines.en: I settle back into that pose.
We approach from opposite ends of the cave.
We each crouch and circle slowly.
Her joints click more than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在黑暗里并排站着。
lines.en: We stand side by side in the dark.
Neither of us moves first.
She reaches over and touches my neck.

lines.zh: 我们的影子和石头分不开。
lines.en: Our shadows can't be told from the stone.

lines.zh: 她走开，我跟了两步就停。
lines.en: She leaves; I follow two steps and stop.
The silence lasts a long while.
Only dripping water is left in the cave.
I bite it and something crunches.
I fling it against the wall.
It falls into a crack beyond my reach.
I carry it in my mouth on four limbs.
It crumbles under my claw.

lines.zh: 这东西太轻，抓着没感觉。
lines.en: It's too light to feel.

lines.zh: 我把它推来推去，玩了一会儿。
lines.en: I push it back and forth a while.

lines.zh: 最后我把它扔进了暗处。
lines.en: Finally I throw it into the dark.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子折了个角。
lines.en: I raise my head at a broken angle.
You moved, and I stop waiting.
All four limbs take the ground at once.
I burst out of the cave.
I've marked your direction.

lines.zh: 这一声叫，从我胸腔里出来。
lines.en: This scream comes out of my chest.
My back arches as if it might snap.

lines.zh: 距离九十六步，我够得着。
lines.en: Ninety-six paces; still within reach.

lines.zh: 我不再眨眼，也不会走开。
lines.en: I won't blink again, and I won't leave.
Stone walls won't hold me.
I lower my head and push forward.
I've heard too many people run.
The first sound is yours.

lines.zh: 我说过要来，现在就来了。
lines.en: I said I was coming, and here I am.
This ground is mine to patrol.
I chase along the wall without slowing.
You take a side passage; so do I.
I smash through the stone in my way.
Pebbles fall from the roof as I pass.
Your torch wavers ahead.
I run and scream at the same time.

lines.zh: 你身上的重量我听得出来。
lines.en: I can hear the weight you carry.
I take a shortcut, over the top.

lines.zh: 这一带的岔口我都走过。
lines.en: I've walked every fork here.
You stop to breathe and I close in.
I break the dirt wall with a limb.
You're heading up; I'm faster.
My claws bite the rock.

lines.zh: 你听见我了吗？我在你后面。
lines.en: Can you hear me? I'm behind you.
The passage narrows ahead.
I turn sideways and block it.
My breath is at the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 你摔在碎石上，慢慢爬吧。
lines.en: You hit the gravel; crawl if you can.
I hit from the side and take you down.
All four limbs press down at once.
I bite your collar.
You're dragged across the stone.

lines.zh: 这一下擦过，只破了一层皮。
lines.en: It grazes and only breaks the skin.
I pin the back of your knee.
You hit my ribs with a dull thud.
I pull back and lunge, never stopping.
I drive my forehead into your chest.

lines.zh: 爪子刮过木板，五道口子。
lines.en: Claws rake the boards and leave five lines.
You struggle beneath me.
I stop screaming and only pant.
I drag you toward the cave mouth.
The last one — I hold you down.

lines.zh: 我从洞口的暗处爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the dark at the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 四条腿先落地，头最后抬。
lines.en: Four limbs land first; the head comes up last.
The air in the cave thickens.

lines.zh: 我的关节一节节响起来。
lines.en: My joints click, one after another.

lines.zh: 我伏在石头上，向你这边看。
lines.en: I crouch on the stone and look your way.
It's dark outside — good.
I test the ground first.
Water seeps from the cracks.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴着地面拉长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches flat on the ground.
I hold still and wait for you to move.
This step is very slow.
The roof is low; I crawl under it.
My smell soaks into the stone.
A bat flies off in the distance.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁，开始听动静。
lines.en: I press to the stone and start listening.

lines.zh: 有活的东西进了这一片。
lines.en: Something living has entered this place.

lines.zh: 我不必藏，这里本来就黑。
lines.en: I needn't hide; it's dark here already.
All four claws have a grip.
I'm waiting for a sound.

lines.zh: 火光照亮我，我的皮在响。
lines.en: Firelight shows me and my skin crackles.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶掉下来，砸在地上。
lines.en: I fall from the roof and hit the floor.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我四条腿乱蹬。
lines.en: Water rises and all four limbs thrash.
The blast throws me into the wall.
An arrow buries in my back.
That light leaves me unable to move.

lines.zh: 饿了太久，我撑不起身子。
lines.en: Too long starved; I can't lift myself.

lines.zh: 雷劈在洞口，我整只缩紧。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the mouth and I clench tight.

lines.zh: 石头没了，我什么都没有抓住。
lines.en: The stone is gone and I catch nothing.
